title: A quote with no prefix or suffix still resolves exactly when it is unique
rationale: prefix and suffix are SHOULD, not MUST. An engine that requires them in order to anchor would reject conforming annotations produced by another engine.

requirement.text: Wherever the annotation target is text, the engine MUST produce a TextQuoteSelector ...; its prefix and suffix SHOULD be populated to disambiguate repeated text.

input.content: The district is piloting local-first software this term.
